narration.text: Keep the performance. Change the character.

notes: A native Aftertake Film: genuine UI states with authored camera moves, tracked source-pixel duplicates and finishing, local H3 character replacement, native LTX-2.5 reference animation, locally voiced Kokoro narration and independently editable motion graphics. The reveal shows this 16-cut,16-title,19-graphic,11-sound-clip project at the three-copies hero frame (1.3333s), captured in the actual editor. No simulated cursor or continuous-screen-recording claim. Original public/licensed example assets; no private user photos or hosted API generation.
